scope: Wave-1 states only (CA, DE, FL, IL, MA, NJ, NY, PA, TX, VA)
methodology: Primary inputs: jurisdiction-sources.ts officialRegulationUrl / officialCourtRulesUrl and wave2c-regulation-source-registry.json.
Missing Wave-1 URLs filled from well-known official .gov entry points; HTTP HEAD/GET spot-check 2026-09-18.
Commercial Lexis/Westlaw wrappers flagged E_terms_unclear; not recommended for automated ingestion.
No public APIs assumed or invented.

platformFamiliesAllStates.notes: NJ Administrative Code and Register are officially published by Lexis; free hottopics mirror is explicitly non-official. Similar official-publisher arrangements appear in other states (e.g., CT, RI, WV) — verify per state before ingestion.

platformFamiliesAllStates.family: Thomson Reuters / Westlaw (official online browse contract)
platformFamiliesAllStates.notes: CA CCR and NY NYCRR free online browse run on Westlaw under state contract; sites label content unofficial or non-evidentiary. OAL/DOS remain official compilers.
Shared HTML browse pattern for statutes and admin code on one legislative domain (section URLs, title TOC, PDF export).

platformFamiliesAllStates.family: Secretary of State / register + code portals
platformFamiliesAllStates.notes: Custom SOS-hosted HTML for administrative register and codified rules; often long-lived static or semi-static pages.
Unified official code + register site maintained by legislative staff.
Agency CMS pages for CMR/regulations; structured HTML but often bot-protected.
Common for municipalities; some state-adjacent compilations. Treat as secondary unless confirmed official.
Unofficial mirrors — useful for human lookup only; do not use as corpus authority.

courtRulesTractable.sourceOwner: Pennsylvania Legislative Reference Bureau (Pa Code Title 231 — court rules)
courtRulesTractable.notes: Court rules codified in Pa Code; same stable HTML platform as regulations. Verified 200.
Central rules hub with links to supreme, appellate, and trial rules. Verified 200.
Official SCV rules index; trial rules on separate vacourts pages. Verified 200.
